display_name: Shoulder blade squeeze on the bar
description: A targeted pull-up bar exercise that strengthens scapular depressors and sets the foundation for strict pull-ups.
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip at shoulder-width, arms fully straight in a relaxed dead hang.
steps: Without bending your elbows, draw your shoulder blades down and back.
Lift your chest slightly toward the bar while keeping your arms locked.
Hold the contracted active hang at the top for one second.
Smoothly relax your shoulders to return to the dead hang position.
cues: Keep elbows locked straight like steel rods throughout
Pull shoulder blades down into your back pockets

mistakes.fix: Keep arms completely straight; movement comes purely from shoulder blades
Brace abs and squeeze legs together to keep torso still

rep_standard: Begins in passive dead hang with straight arms, elevates torso solely through shoulder blade depression, and returns fully to passive hang.
